title: 4 hours Winter Off-Road ATV Experience in Lake Tahoe
includes: Navigation equipment is provided along with a SPOT satellite GPS tracker
List of sites/attractions to riders who want to adventure on their own
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Minimum age to carry a minor: 25
All drivers of off-road vehicles are required to have a valid driver's license
All passengers must be able to grasp a handhold with their hands, plant feet firmly on the ground, and have their back fully against the backrest
Helmets and eye protection are always required to be worn when the vehicle is being operated.
All drivers of off-road vehicles are required to be 18+ years of age with a valid driver’s license and be accompanied by a passenger over 25
Bring extra layers like a lightweight jacket or sweatshirt in case of weather changes.
Feel free to bring along a backpack with water, snacks, bug spray, and sunscreen.
Guests are recommended to wear closed-toe shoes as well as appropriate clothing for the weather conditions to ensure a comfortable ride.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This self-guided off-road vehicle rental begins at the designated hub near Stateline, Nevada, where travelers check in, complete safety briefings, and learn to operate the tracked vehicle. Renters must present a valid driver’s license and security deposit card upon arrival. Participants should wear sturdy closed-toe shoes and weather-appropriate layers. Helmets and safety gear are provided and must be worn during the excursion. Additional expenses like fuel surcharges or optional damage waivers are not included in the base price. Renters navigate authorized local trails independently for the reserved duration, adhering strictly to safety guidelines and route boundaries. Upon completion, travelers return the vehicle to the starting location to finish the check-out process.
